The ultimate windstopper essential, Lina is constructed from a 100% recycled 37gsm Pertex Quantum fabric. The fully windproof core is DWR coated and is matched with a breathable rear section for optimum temperature control, while the YKK two-way zip adds to Lina’s flexibility and practicality. Lina comes in handy during early mornings and long descents, and stashes away in its own pocket, taking up the smallest of spaces during long days in the saddle.

Ivana is a new concept in jerseys, featuring the high-tech, open-weave Primaloft Active Evolve fabric. Active Evolve is incredibly breathable, but, when used under a windproof or waterproof layer, is highly insulating – for use on cool days when you don’t know what’s coming. Thanks to its construction and fabric, Ivana is super light, and the three cargo pockets and zipped valuable pocket add to its versatility, while the stretch panels ensure a close but comfortable fit.

Designed for routes less travelled and skies less blue, Alizee delivers full rain protection for big adventures. With a PFC-free DWR treatment and an ultra-lightweight Pertex Shield Pro breathable membrane, as well as taped seams and a unique cuff design to prevent water ingress at the most vulnerable point, this lightweight jacket is built to survive the hardest conditions. The full hood is designed to work over a helmet, its elasticated tension system ensuring a close fit and side visibility. A chest pocket and ventilation zips add ultimate practicality.

A highly technical rain jacket that balances superb protection with exceptional performance and ultimate practicality. Featuring a PFC-free DWR treatment, fully taped seams and an ultra-lightweight breathable Pertex Shield Pro membrane, Suzette wards off even the heaviest showers. Its sophisticated pattern around the shoulders minimises wind resistance on the bike, while the unique cuff design prevents water ingress at the most vulnerable point. Styled to reflect life by the water, Suzette is easily packable into a jersey pocket, the ideal layer to carry in capricious conditions.
